title: Bass with Crumble Topping
description: A delicious and easy-to-make bass dish topped with a crumbly mixture. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the bass fillets with sea salt and flour.
Place the bass fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Dot the top of each bass fillet with whisked butter.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the top of each bass fillet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the topping is golden brown.
